title: Queues
definition: A queue is a First-In-First-Out (FIFO) linear data structure.
intuition: Like a waiting line: the first person to arrive is the first served.
how_it_works: Elements are inserted at the back (enqueue) and removed from the front (dequeue).
when_to_use: For BFS, print queues, task scheduling, and buffing.
when_not_to_use: When LIFO or priority-based retrieval is needed.
content: A queue is a First-In-First-Out (FIFO) linear data structure.
